column2: Retain Mount Amoria, the Lord appearing to David and the prepared site at Orna's threshing floor. The selected Amoria form is not silently normalized to another mountain name.
Retain second month and fourth regnal year. No day of the month is added from another witness.

Retain the initial building measurements, sixty cubits by the first measurement and twenty cubits wide. Measurements supplies the contextual introduction; no modern cubit conversion or definite historical standard is asserted.
column3: First measurement may denote an earlier measuring convention, but its precise length remains unestablished here.

column2: Retain ailam, twenty-cubit frontage, the stated 120-cubit height and pure-gold interior. Do not reduce the height to twenty or supply a lost numeral based on architectural expectations.
column3: Ailam's precise architectural rendering and the unusual height require specialist and witness review.

column2: Retain cedar paneling, pure-gold overlay, palm trees and hanging ornaments. Do not substitute cypress wood or interpret the ornaments as definite chains without lexical review.
Retain precious stones for glory and gold from Pharouaim. The location is not identified with another gold source solely from its material.
Retain house, walls, gateways, ceilings and doorways all gilded, and cherubim carved on the walls. The multiple architectural surfaces remain distinct.
Retain the twenty-by-twenty holy chamber, pure gold for cherubim and 600 talents. The selected cherubim phrase is not omitted to create a smoother gold-weight statement.
column3: The attachment of for cherubim to the overlay and weight remains unresolved.

column2: Retain the weight of one nail as fifty gold shekels, the repeated weight wording and gilded upper room. Do not turn the fifty into an aggregate for all nails.
Retain two cherubim explicitly made from wood and overlaid with gold. No carving material is substituted from a different account.
Retain total twenty-cubit wingspan and the two five-cubit wings touching wall and neighboring wing. The total is not assigned to one individual wing.

Retain the repeated wall-to-wing description for the other cherub and both five-cubit lengths. Other is an inherited contextual specification of the selected one cherub at this point in the paired description.
Retain wings spread twenty cubits, standing on their feet and faces toward the house. No alternative facing direction is supplied from the ark's lid imagery elsewhere.
Retain all four curtain materials/colors and woven cherubim. The work is woven, not a second wooden carving.
Retain two pillars with thirty-five-cubit height and five-cubit capitals. Do not replace thirty-five with eighteen or silently divide the figure between pillars.
column3: Whether the stated height is individual or collectively conceived requires architectural review; the reading does not perform an unstated calculation.

column2: Retain serseroth in the dabir, placement on capitals, one hundred pomegranates and hanging ornaments. The two opaque terms remain rather than being guessed from another temple inventory.
column3: Serseroth and its relation to the hanging ornaments require lexical review; dabir remains inherited technical terminology.

column2: Retain right and left placement and the translated selected pillar names Establishment and Strength. Do not replace them with transliterations Jachin and Boaz absent from this Greek clause.
Retain the bronze altar twenty long, twenty wide and ten high, all in cubits. No unstated unit conversion or geometric inference is inserted.
Retain the cast round sea, ten-cubit diameter, five-cubit height and thirty-cubit circumference. The stated measurements are not mathematically corrected.
Retain calf likenesses, ten cubits around the basin and the two-group casting construction. Do not change ten cubits into ten figures per cubit or calves into gourds from another witness.
column3: The construction with two groups, its agent and its relation to the next unit's casting phrase remain unresolved.

column2: Retain the opening casting continuation, twelve calves, three toward each named direction and inward hindquarters beneath the sea. Do not detach the opening phrase as an independent event.
Retain handbreadth thickness, cup-like rim, carved lily shoots, 3,000 metretes and completion. Do not substitute 2,000 or silently convert the unit to baths.
Retain ten basins split five/right and five/left for washing offering preparations, while the sea is for priests. The distinct uses remain without putting priests into the smaller basins.
Retain ten gold lampstands according to ordinance, with five on each side. No assumed single lampstand replaces the selected count.
Retain ten tables divided five and five and a hundred golden bowls. Both furniture and vessel counts are explicit.
Retain priests' court, great court and court doors with bronze-covered doorways. The singular court in the final relation is not expanded into an extra courtyard.
Retain the right-hand corner and east-facing placement of the sea. No southward direction is imported from another account.
Retain Chiram's meat hooks, fire pans, altar grate and all its vessels, and his finishing work for King Solomon. The following inventory supplies the extent of the completed work.
Retain two pillars, golath, chothareth and two covering networks in the selected layered construction. No assumed smooth English capital terminology replaces the borrowed words without review.
column3: The exact architectural objects and the attachment of the repeated heads/tops expressions remain unresolved.

column2: Propose on one network instead of on each network for the selected singular on the one network expression. This avoids silently distributing the two pomegranate groups across both networks. Retain 400 golden bells, two networks, two groups and both golath/chothareth expressions; the close draft preserves each.
column3: Whether one is distributive in context remains open; this is a provisional closer rendering, not an apparatus resolution or architectural reconstruction.

column2: Retain ten mechonoth and basins upon them. The borrowed support term remains unapproved; no number of wheels or extra basins is inferred.
Retain one sea and twelve calves beneath it. This continues the inventory and does not introduce a second sea.
Retain foot pieces, lifting tools, cauldrons, hooks and all vessels, Chiram's production and delivery to Solomon and pure bronze. The selected extra tool categories remain visible.
column3: Foot pieces and lifting tools are provisional lexical renderings; their exact functions are unresolved.

column2: Retain the king as casting agent, Jordan region, thick earth, house of Sokchoth and between Sirdatha. Do not repair the difficult location phrase into a conventional between-two-cities formula.
column3: The meaning of thick earth and the two location constructions require review; no clay-mold technology is added as certain.

column2: Retain abundance because the bronze supply by weight did not run out. Do not replace the selected non-exhaustion statement with a claim that its weight was never measured.
Retain Solomon making all house vessels, the golden altar and plural tables with presentation bread. The selected plural remains despite other accounts' singular table.
Retain gold lampstands and light lamps, ordinance and position before the dabir. The material applies within the continued inventory rather than a new narrative event.
Retain tongs, lamps, bowls, incense cups and fire pans of pure gold. No flower ornaments are inserted from another vessel list.
Retain the singular inner door toward the Holy of Holies and the plural golden temple-house doors. The final fragmentary relation is not replaced by a complete hinge description.
column3: The relation expressed by for the golden doors remains unresolved; this is provisional inherited syntax.

column2: Retain completion, David's consecrated silver/gold/vessels and their placement in the treasury. Fresh complete Greek retrieval succeeds now, while the historical English-only review record remains unchanged.
Retain elders, all tribal rulers and ancestral leaders gathered to Jerusalem to bring the covenant ark from David's city, identified as Zion. The parenthetical place identification remains.
Retain all Israel's men, the feast and the seventh-month explanation. No festival name or calendar day is added where unexpressed.
Retain all elders arriving and all Levites taking the ark. The carrying group here is explicitly Levites, not silently replaced with priests from the later placement clause.
Retain ark, tent and all holy vessels, followed by singular it and both priests and Levites bringing it up. The singular pronoun is not mechanically pluralized to match the preceding objects.
column3: It may refer to the ark or tent within the collective transport account; the antecedent remains open.

column2: Retain Solomon, congregation, those who feared and their assembled ones, with uncountable calves and sheep. No object God is inserted into the bare fearing description.
column3: The relation of the two additional collective groups to the congregation remains unresolved. Could neither be numbered nor reckoned renders the future negatives contextually as innumerability.

column2: Retain priests bringing the covenant ark to its place in the dabir/Holy of Holies under the cherubim's wings. The nested location descriptions are not reduced to one generic sanctuary noun.
Retain spread wings over the ark's place and covering both ark and carrying poles from above. The poles remain part of the described shelter.

Retain projecting poles, visible ends from the holy places before the dabir but not outside, and their presence to this day. Do not make the ark rather than poles the unexpressed plural subject of the final clause.
Retain the exclusive two tablets, Moses placing them at Choreb and the covenant construction at the exodus. No manna vessel or staff is added to the expressly restricted contents.
column3: The relative linking tablets and what the Lord covenanted is grammatically difficult; the inherited which clause remains provisional.

column2: Retain priests coming out, all present priests sanctified and their not being arranged by course. The long sentence continues through the musicians into verse 13; no limited on-duty group is substituted.

Retain the full Levitical singing groups, sons and brethren, linen robes, three instrument categories and 120 trumpet-playing priests opposite the altar. Heman is the inherited English form for the selected Aiman here and is not silently unified in this pass.
column3: The introductory family attachment and the cross-book Heman/Aiman naming policy remain under review.

column2: Retain one voice repeated, the full instrument list, the explicit thanksgiving command, neuter for it is good and enduring mercy. Propose four display lines: narrative introduction, two selected poetic praise clauses and narrative cloud result. Wording is unchanged.
column3: Whether the neuter good evaluates thanksgiving or expresses divine goodness idiomatically remains open as in 1 Chronicles 16:34.

column2: Retain the priests' inability to stand ministering because of the cloud and the Lord's glory filling God's house. The second glory clause explains the first rather than introducing a separate cloud.
